execution_message.text:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one individual KCK Robot model-sheet reference, not animation or production. Image 1 is the ONLY approved identity/rendering reference (corrected Robot). Preserve Soft Handmade 2.5D: dark warm brown hand outline, cold gray lightly textured casing, blue hands and block boots, red antenna ends and cheeks, gentle upper-left light. Preserve box-shaped head with planar depth, two red-tipped antennas, long segmented limbs, outward raised arms, rectangular smiling mouth and tongue. Each visible open dark oval eye has EXACTLY ONE large white highlight at SCREEN UPPER LEFT; no lower/right highlight. Four chest controls in anatomical consistent front order: screen upper-left BLUE CIRCLE, upper-right YELLOW TRIANGLE, lower-left RED CIRCLE, lower-right GREEN RECTANGLE. Preserve proportions, limb segments and body panel geometry. One whole character, generous transparent margins, no cropping, genuine alpha, no floor/shadow/matte/text/panels/new prop or accessory. Do not change colors, shorten limbs, invent extra controls or mirror handedness. Same original pose and neutral expression except requested camera/expression. Individual square canvas with preserved proportions, no multi-view collage. View: Strict SIDE profile facing screen RIGHT: head AND torso AND boots in the same 90-degree orientation. Single visible eye with one upper-left highlight. Both antenna roots where projection permits, far limbs naturally occluded. Chest front panel lies on the facing-right plane, not pasted facing camera; no new side controls. Retain long two-leg structure and segmented raised arms in projected side view.

Revision for a separately authorized bounded retry/new-mouth sheet set: Image 1 is the newly selected soft-handmade-v1-mouthfix Robot. Preserve its coherent rectangular smile, short rounded pink tongue and thin central tongue fold wherever the mouth is visible. No separate hanging lower rectangle, elongated tongue or heavy dark center bar. Preserve one SCREEN UPPER-LEFT primary eye glint per visible eye; do not add a second glint. Light every rounded red antenna cap consistently from SCREEN UPPER LEFT: the light patch belongs in its screen upper-left quadrant, the shade in lower-right. Never put the light patch on upper-right. Keep the soft handmade paper texture and warm brown outline. Preserve chest symbols, segmented long limbs, two complete blue boots and two red antenna caps; do not crop any extremity. Center the full body on the canvas with generous true transparent margins, no detached haze, backdrop, shadow or extra prop. Keep the reference rendering and character anatomy while making only the specified model-sheet view/expression.
